jobs.name: Turtle
jobs.prompt: The attached image is only a board of the game's approved art STYLE: copy its style (chunky stylized low-poly game art, flat-shaded facets, bold clean colors, simple eyes), never its fish, poses or camera, and do not draw any of them. Draw ONE clean model sheet for 3D conversion of a GREEN SEA TURTLE, a touch more realistic in proportion than a toy: a broad, gently domed oval shell built of distinct large faceted SCUTES (five down the middle, four along each side, a ring of small scutes round the rim), each scute deep olive-green with a darker olive-brown center and thin dark seams between them; a rounded head covered in big polygonal scales with a short hooked BEAK, a short neck; two long, flat, paddle-shaped front flippers and two short rounded hind flippers, all covered in distinct polygonal scales, dark olive-green outlined by thin mid olive-grey seams; the skin and the underside a mid-toned olive-grey-green (never cream, yellow, tan, beige, pink or peach anywhere); a short pointed tail. Its eye small and simple, a dark pupil with a tiny glint, never a googly cartoon eye; its beak closed. The turtle alone, large and centered, filling most of the frame, seen in a three-quarter view from above and from the front-left so the top of the shell, the head and all four flippers show, held flat and level in a neutral pose with all four flippers spread straight out to the sides, flat and fully visible, none tucked under the shell or overlapping. Plain flat pale grey background, no ground shadow, no water, no bubbles, no other objects, no text, no watermark.

jobs.name: Humpback
jobs.prompt: The TOP of the attached image is the approved design of a HUMPBACK WHALE, shown dead on the sea floor; the strip at the BOTTOM only shows the game's art style (do not copy its fish). Redraw the whale ALIVE and WHOLE as ONE clean model sheet for 3D conversion: chunky stylized low-poly game art, flat-shaded facets, bold clean colors, soft even lighting, the same long chunky faceted body, slate blue-grey back and cool mid blue-grey grooved throat and belly as the design (mid-toned, never white), knobbly bumps on the head, a small dorsal fin, a few clusters of grey barnacles on the chin and the flippers.
